title: underscore: locate why a negative fromIndex searches from the start
prompt: In this copy of Underscore 1.13.7, a negative `fromIndex` no longer counts from the end of the array: `_.indexOf([1,2,3,2,1], 2, -2)` returns 1 instead of 3, `_.contains([1,2,3,2,1], 3, -2)` returns true instead of false, and `_.includes` agrees with `contains`. Non-negative indexes, `lastIndexOf` and the NaN and sorted-array paths are fine. Trace which internal helper the affected functions share, find the root cause and fix it with a minimal change.
